scientific.integrity: The claim is derived from the exact closed mirror map, the proved polynomial form of the higher-genus potential, and the proved all-genus critical numerator. The remaining step is an explicit quadratic change of local coordinate and the standard transfer theorem for algebraic singularities; no numerical fitting or finite-degree extrapolation is used.
limitations: The result is a leading asymptotic for fixed p and fixed genus g at large degree; it is not a simultaneous large-genus/large-degree expansion.
Only genera g>=2 are covered because genus zero and one have different singular forms.
The normalization is that of Guo--Xu--Zhang; older local-curve papers use a shifted parameter convention.

title: Rigorous all-genus large-degree asymptotics for the local curves X_p
